title: Positive Black Soul forms in Dakar
description: The group’s profile records its creation in August 1989 by Didier Awadi and Doug E. Tee.

title: Positive Black Soul opens MC Solaar’s first Dakar show
description: Positive Black Soul opened MC Solaar’s first Dakar show in October 1992.

title: Positive Black Soul performs in Paris
description: RFI documents the group’s Paris appearance at the Bataclan in 1993.

title: Positive Black Soul releases Boul Falé
description: RFI records the cassette release of Boul Falé in 1994.

title: Reggie Rockstone returns to Ghana
description: BBC coverage describes Rockstone’s return in 1994 and his role in popularizing hiplife.

title: New York/Paris/Dakar receives international release
description: RFI documents the international release and the album’s collaboration with KRS-One.

title: Olamide releases Eni Duro
description: The Guardian identifies Eni Duro as Olamide’s first hit, recorded mostly in Yoruba, and places it within the rise of indigenous-language rap from mainland Lagos.

title: Nasty C records Lost Files in Johannesburg
description: OkayAfrica reports that Nasty C recorded the Lost Files EP from his Johannesburg home during the COVID-19 lockdown.
